prompt: Show me how to create a custom xAI TTS voice from reference.wav and then use that voice to generate custom.mp3. Make it clear this should only be run when I opt in.
assertions: Uses POST https://api.x.ai/v1/custom-voices with multipart file upload
Extracts voice_id from the custom voice creation response
Uses the custom voice_id in a subsequent POST https://api.x.ai/v1/tts request
Clearly warns that custom voice creation is opt-in and not part of automated smoke tests
